title: Andromeda
body: ![Andromeda banner](https://us-east-1.tixte.net/uploads/melontini.tixte.co/Andromeda_Banner_Thin_x0.5.jpg) **Highly configurable, modular tweaks/additions mod!** [![Follow on Bluesky!](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zenfyrdev/mini-badges/v1/social/bluesky/follow.svg)](https://bsky.app/profile/did:plc:udgxgv72u6qheiwgwfahqylp) [![Compatible with Launchpad](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sinytra/.github/refs/heads/main/badges/launchpad/compatible/compacter.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/launchpad) *** Andromeda is a highly configurable mod with over 40 different modules. These range from simple value tweaks like farmland fertility control, to new functional items and mechanics. Hightlights include: ### GUI Particles [Wiki Entry](https://andromeda.zenfyr.dev/gui/#gui-particles) This tweak adds particle effects to various GUIs, such as the anvil, enchantment table, furnace, and the creative inventory. ### Magnet [Wiki Entry](https://andromeda.zenfyr.dev/items/#magnet) ### Loot Barrels [Wiki Entry](https://andromeda.zenfyr.dev/world/#loot-barrels) Add random barrels with loot to caves! **And more!** Interested? Check out all the currently available modules on our wiki! [andromeda.zenfyr.dev](https://andromeda.zenfyr.dev/) ## Dependencies: [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and [Pulsar](https://modrinth.com/mod/pulsar) are required! [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) are highly recommended on client! ## FAQ: - *Can I suggest a feature for the mod?* Yes! We accept suggestions on our [GitHub](https://github.com/constellation-mc/andromeda/discussions/categories/ideas) or [Discord](https://zenfyr.dev/constellation-discord). - *Will you port to X minecraft version?* Newer versions - Yes, older versions - No. More info here: [Updates Policy](https://github.com/constellation-mc/docs/blob/main/UPDATES.md#minecraft-versions) - *Will you port to X mod loader?* Probably not! Andromeda targets Fabric, but *may* support compatibility tools such as Connector or Launchpad in the future. More info here: [Updates Policy](https://github.com/constellation-mc/docs/blob/main/UPDATES.md#mod-loaders) *** 💜
